description: Benchmark-author golden path: a deliberately small keyed-retrieval benchmark with a committed frozen input, a Gauntlet-bound runner, descriptor-driven normalization, and evaluator-integrity negative controls that can fail. It demonstrates the contributor contract; it is not independent evidence about any memory system.

source_rights.acquisition_notes: No acquisition step: the exact input is committed and digest-bound.

selection.identity_rule: all:<first 16 hex of input sha256>; the full declared query set is always executed

native_metrics.description: fraction of queries whose rank-1 recalled id equals gold_id
fraction of queries whose gold_id appears within the first three recalled ids
number of operation envelopes issued through the adapter
fraction of adapter responses that validated against the operation-envelope schema

native_artifacts.description: per-query rows, recalled ids, and the full operation transcript
common evidence manifest derived only from declared mappings
negotiation, coverage, failure attribution, and artifact digests

budget.retrieval_or_context_budget: recall limit 3 per query; no answer-generation context budget

failure_semantics.description: the first non-ok operation response blocks the run with its attributed source; input digest mismatch is attributed to benchmark_input before any operation is issued

system_requirements.unsupported_semantics: systems need no lifecycle, governance, or durability capability; unsupported optional capabilities remain unsupported in the qualification output and never become numeric zero

mappings.semantics: rank-1 exact gold id match over all queries; baseline_or_probe evidence
gold id within the first three recalled ids; baseline_or_probe evidence
every adapter response crossed the operation-envelope validator
exact frozen input digest verified against the descriptor

unmapped_dimensions.currentness: not_applicable: single-version records, no update or conflict protocol
unmapped_dimensions.governance: not_applicable: one namespace, no isolation or admission claim is exercised
unmapped_dimensions.efficiency: not_measured: timings are retained natively but are not mapped for a demonstration benchmark

negative_controls.description: every gold record is dropped at the remember boundary; exact_top1 must fall
the top two recalled items are swapped; exact_top1 must fall while recall_at_3 is unaffected
recalled ids are rewritten; exact_top1 must fall because id mapping is part of the protocol
records that are gold for no query are dropped; exact_top1 must not change, proving the evaluator reacts to the relevant defect only

evaluator_integrity.qualification_expectation: all_as_expected must be true against the repository lexical baseline; a control whose detection diverges from its declared expectation disqualifies the evaluator, not the system

seed.note: deterministic fixture order and deterministic scoring; no sampling

reproducibility.revision_binding: descriptor digest + known_input_sha256 + adapter manifest digest + system/adapter revisions recorded in qualification.json

gauntlet.reason: the protocol is fully expressible through describe/reset/remember/recall operation envelopes, so any system adapter can enter without protocol loss

limitations: baseline_or_probe evidence for the contributor contract; not an external efficacy benchmark
ten records and eight queries exercise ranking among lexically similar siblings only
no currentness, governance, lifecycle, or efficiency claim is measured
